ownership_model.columns_added: account_id on projects, revisions, assets, Avatar Profiles/versions, Image Styles/versions, queue entries, dispatch authorizations, attempts, outputs, costs, approvals, and audits
ownership_model.constraint: composite foreign key (account_id, workspace_id) -> workspaces (account_id, id) on every tenant table
ownership_model.closure: existing workspace-composite child keys plus the new scope key make a cross-tenant row unrepresentable
ownership_model.derivation: account_id is derived by database trigger from the already-authorized parent row; a supplied value is overwritten, never honoured

backfill.pre_v2_workspaces: adopted by the reserved LEGACY account
backfill.pre_v2_rows: inherit the legacy scope through their workspace
backfill.legacy_and_system_accounts: status NON_LOGIN with no owner_user_id, so no identity can ever authenticate into them
backfill.pre_v2_admissions: receive a fresh empty USER account and default workspace rather than the legacy scope

trusted_principal.type: WorkspaceScope carries accountId plus an unforgeable brand
trusted_principal.client_supplied_owner: cannot typecheck into a repository call and is overwritten at the database if it reaches SQL
trusted_principal.session_binding: the unit of work sets videoforge.account_id from the principal for the whole transaction
trusted_principal.scope_guard: unit-of-work repository calls must match both the bound account and workspace
trusted_principal.auth_boundary: WorkspaceAccessRecord and the granted authorization now carry the account read from the durable row

identity_binding.behaviour: invite redemption atomically creates one account, one default workspace, and one membership
identity_binding.upgrade: an identity that already owns an account adopts it instead of creating a second tenant
identity_binding.returning_login: resolves its workspace from the admitted account, never from the request

rls_truth.declared: every tenant table enables and forces row level security and declares its tenant policy
rls_truth.reason: PGlite connects as a superuser, which bypasses row level security regardless of FORCE
rls_truth.enforced_and_proven_instead: the tenant write guard trigger and the videoforge_tenant_* views, both of which apply to the table owner
rls_truth.production_boundary: the declared policies govern the non-superuser application role on Neon and remain unproven until V2-06 hosted staging
